description:
## 1.2.1

A cleaner Vibe settings dialog with a Material 3 switch and no Appearance subtitle. Dark login screens keep the Google button white and fields readable. Patch names and descriptions are easier to read, and Yanosik 26.9.0 no longer carries the Experimental label.

Local PRO stays local; server-only perks are unchanged. Reduce tracking also blocks RevenueCat purchases and subscription syncing.
